overview: The adaptation preserves existing current58 metadata CAS and separates incomplete resource staging from authority. The final binding is not required to equal its independently reviewed full scope before metadata execution and CAS.

requested_changes.problem: scope_build projects a pre-review binding into the reviewed scope. A later final binding is validated independently but never compared to that scope. prepare validates CLI2 from scope yet WIP values come from final binding; grant also uses binding runtime/helper/code facts without first proving the full binding/scope projection matches.
requested_changes.concrete_NOT_RUN_counterexample: Keep the genuine reviewed e2/current58 scope and its exact hash/controller review. Change only final b.desktop_scope_values.current58_CLI2_qualification_ref to a different valid pinned file such as the historical a510 qualification. binding verifies file bytes and prepare.validate_cli2 checks only the original scope. wip_values then writes the different binding ref to CP during CAS. validate_authority later rejects WIP!=scope (adapter6a lines464–465), after the new registered lease and tuple exist. This demonstrates delayed refusal and incorrect state, not a claimed product authority bypass.
requested_changes.related_scope_inputs: The same missing invariant covers all shared root/code/runtime/compiler/toolchain/currentauthority/budget/observation-path/tuple fields and metadata guard code refs. Current controller review pins the scope hash, not an arbitrary different final binding.
requested_changes.minimum_fix: Extract a pure project_scope(b, verified_template)->complete_scope_dict and retain verified scope_template_ref in final binding. Assert actual reviewed scope exactly equals the projection before prepare loads/imports gate/runtime or writes draft files, and before grant allocates preflight/auth roots. Freeze all basis refs and metadata_code_refs inside the projected scope so cut/canonical/source/template/metadata inputs cannot change after full-scope review.
requested_changes.cycle_boundary: controller_review_ref remains outside the projection, while predetermined controller_review_path stays within it. Only its pre-review NULL to later actual review-ref binding changes. Never include final binding's own ref or future review hash in scope.
requested_changes.proposed_scope_field_boundary: Root_metadata_binding_inputs and scope_template_ref additions are proposals requiring independent source/full-scope review; this report does not adopt them.
requested_changes.owned_attempt_record: Existing mode.started.json can still preserve an owned attempted call before a rejected projection. No candidate/helper import, runtime/native call, draft mutation, pf/auth mkdir or canonical write may precede the projection match.
future_controls_NOT_RUN: Matching pre-review and final binding projection remains reachable despite NULL→real controller_review_ref
Change only CLI2 qualification/ref after scope freeze rejects before CAS
Change cut/canonical/source-prefix/template or metadata_code_refs rejects before CAS
